description: Confirm an impact at t as a fall candidate when the gravity direction differs from the mean over [t-2.0 s, t-1.0 s] by at least 50 degrees: as soon as a sliding 0.25 s window starting from t+0.25 s shows it with every sample within 10 degrees of the window mean, otherwise at t+1.5 s from the mean over [t+0.5 s, t+1.5 s]. Chosen on CGU-BES Subject01-12 (train+validation) only.
